# Dimension 1: Todoist Platform & API Capabilities

Reference file for the Todoist PA integration research.
See [citations.md](../citations.md) for source details.

## Feature Set

Todoist provides a task management platform with: projects (hierarchical with sub-projects),
labels (cross-project tagging via @ symbol), filters (custom views with query syntax),
priorities (P1-P4, P1 highest), reminders (Pro-only), sections (within-project grouping),
comments (on tasks or projects), and task durations (amount + unit) [1][9][34].

## REST API (v1)

The REST API is at `/api/v1/` with full CRUD endpoints [1]:

| Resource | Endpoints | Key Operations |
|----------|-----------|----------------|
| Tasks | 11 | list, create, get, update, delete, close, reopen, quick_add, move, completed_by_date |
| Projects | 10+ | list, create, get, update, delete, archive/unarchive, search, collaborators |
| Sections | 5 | CRUD + archive |
| Labels | 6 | CRUD + search |
| Comments | 5 | CRUD |
| Reminders | 5 | CRUD |
| Filters | 4 | CRUD |
| User | 3 | get info, update, productivity_stats |
| Activity | 1 | logs |
| Backups | 2 | list, download |

### Task Object Fields

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | string | Unique identifier |
| content | string | Task title |
| description | string | Task description |
| project_id | string | Parent project |
| section_id | string | Parent section |
| parent_id | string | Parent task (for subtasks) |
| priority | int | 1 (P4/normal) to 4 (P1/urgent) |
| due | object | date, datetime, timezone, string |
| duration | object | amount + unit |
| label_ids | array | Attached labels |
| completed | boolean | Completion status |
| assignee_id | string | Assigned user |
| order | int | Sort position |

[1]

### Due Date Formats

- Full-day: `"2024-12-31"` [1]
- Floating time: `"2024-12-31T15:30:00"` [1]
- Fixed timezone: `"2024-12-31T15:30:00+02:00"` [1]

## Authentication

| Method | Use Case | Details |
|--------|----------|---------|
| Personal API token | Single-user, testing | From integration settings [3] |
| OAuth 2.0 | Production apps | 3-step authorization code flow [3] |

### OAuth Scopes

| Scope | Access Level |
|-------|-------------|
| data:read | Read-only — sufficient for advisory PA [3] |
| task:add | Create tasks only [3] |
| data:read_write | Full read/write [3] |
| data:delete | Delete resources [3] |
| project:delete | Delete projects [3] |
| backups:read | Read backups [3] |

Token migration from personal to OAuth and RFC 7009 revocation supported [3].

## Sync API (v9)

The Sync API at `POST /api/v1/sync` provides capabilities beyond REST [2]:

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Batching | Single request handles multiple reads/writes [2] |
| Incremental sync | sync_token retrieves only modified resources [2] |
| Command chaining | Temporary IDs allow dependent operations in one request [2] |
| No push | Clients must poll; no real-time push notifications [2] |

### Sync-Only Data (Not Available via REST)

- workspace_users (only in incremental sync) [2]
- Live notifications with state tracking [2]
- Day orders (task sequencing in daily views) [2]
- Completed info aggregations [2]

## Rate Limits

| API | Limit | Source |
|-----|-------|--------|
| REST | 1000 requests / 15 min / user | [10] |
| Sync | 50 requests / min / user | [2] |
| Sync commands | 100 commands / request | [2] |
| Request body | 1 MiB max | [10] |
| Header | 65 KiB max | [10] |
| Processing | 15-second timeout | [10] |

Rate-limited requests return HTTP 429 with `retry_after` value [1].

## Webhooks

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Delivery | HTTPS POST payloads [3][27] |
| Events | item:added, item:updated, item:deleted [3][27] |
| Verification | HMAC-SHA256 signature [3][27] |
| Requirements | HTTPS endpoint, no custom ports [3][27] |
| Activation | When users complete OAuth for webhook-enabled apps [3][27] |

## Pricing

| Feature | Beginner (Free) | Pro | Business |
|---------|-----------------|-----|----------|
| Personal projects | 5 | 300 | 300 + 500 team |
| Filter views | 3 | 150 | 150 |
| Activity history | 1 week | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| File uploads | 5 MB | 100 MB | 100 MB |
| Reminders | No | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar layout | No | Yes | Yes |
| Task duration | No | Yes | Yes |
| Task Assist AI | No | Yes | Yes |
| Deadlines | No | Yes | Yes |
| Collaborators/project | 5 | 5 | 50 |
| Team workspace | No | No | Yes |
| SOC2 Type II | No | No | Yes |

Pro price: ~$5/mo annual billing (est.). Business: ~$8/user/mo annual (est.) — exact amounts vary by locale [4].

## Gaps and Limitations

- Full webhook event catalog may be broader than the three documented events [3]
- API version naming in transition: URLs reference `/rest/v2/` but endpoints now at `/api/v1/` [1]
- Free tier's 3 filter views and lack of reminders limit PA functionality [4]
- No real-time push mechanism; webhooks or Sync API polling required [2][27]
